A chain wears out faster when it is left dry because the lubricant inside the chain relies on moisture to function properly. When the chain dries out, the metal components begin to rub against each other directly, causing friction, wear, and premature deterioration of the chain links and rollers. This friction leads to a loss of lubrication, which accelerates the wear process significantly.
